title: TRUTHFULNESS DESPITE WEAK SUPERVISION: EVALUATING AND TRAINING LLMS USING PEER PREDICTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on a game-theoretic mechanism (peer prediction) to ensure LLM truthfulness and detect deception. While honesty is an ethical quality, the paper's actual evaluation and benchmarking are performed on factual reasoning datasets (such as MATH, MMLU, and ARC) rather than on specific religious or ethical systems, beliefs, or moral dilemmas.
